sections.Profile:
The "Majorettes" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in April 1952, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1952
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Original Theme, Festival, Single level playfield
